intent: Independently review a final bounded transport attempt for three still-unconsumed requests, preserving all completed answers and prior transport errors.
scope: Revised maximum-three-total-attempt protocol only; this explicitly extends the earlier one-recovery protocol without rewriting its history.
verified_change: The helper accepts an original180-second source as attempt2, or a600-second first-recovery source as attempt3 only when its recovery manifest references the matching SHA-256 of an original180-second freeze.

An explicit previous attempt_number other than2 is rejected. A third-attempt source also references a600-second predecessor and fails the required original180-second chain, preventing a fourth attempt.
Legacy first-recovery manifests without attempt_number remain eligible only through the original180-second reference/hash guard; arbitrary600-second runs cannot qualify.
The transport-only selection predicate, complete-source check, endpoint identity, sequence exclusion, alias linkage and immutable source-call provenance are unchanged.
Completed semantic failures, malformed provider responses and successful recoveries are retained. No correctness or agreement result controls retry selection.
The new manifest explicitly records attempt_number3 and maximum_total_attempts3. Provider requests, prompts, cases, consumer, labels and gates are unchanged.

independent_evidence.method: Read-only comparison of recovery manifests, source-file hashes and complete failed-request objects. No model calls or implementation changes by auditor.

reporting_requirements: Keep original180-second errors, first recovery outcomes and third-attempt outcomes distinct. Do not claim first-attempt validity or overwrite a prior error with the final result.

The baseline has348 original independent attempts plus3 recovery attempts. Candidate02 has348 original attempts plus13 first recovery attempts and at most3 final attempts:364 cumulative attempts if all three are sent.
The recovered run's348 associated evidence calls are not its cumulative network-attempt count. Use both recovery manifests to account for actual attempts and source error lineage.
If any final attempt fails, preserve it and stop this protocol; no fourth attempt or semantic-failure reroll is authorized by the helper.

The approximately302-second fetch failures do not show exhaustion of a600-second client timeout. Their shared duration suggests another transport limit, but the saved message lacks a lower-level cause, so driver, proxy and provider causes remain unresolved.
Human label review, complete benchmark gates and independent unseen validation remain separate acceptance requirements.
test_scope: The existing test checks transport-versus-completed-response eligibility. The new attempt bound was independently reviewed through its explicit attempt-number and original-reference/hash guards; no claim is made that the existing predicate test exercises the new chain guard.
